She points to her face while gesturing expressively with her hands. The background consists of a parking lot, palm trees, and bright natural sunlight. (2) The screen splits horizontally; the top half shows a first-person view of a brown horse's head being petted, while the bottom half maintains a close-up of the woman's inflamed skin. (3) A brief montage shows the woman and two companions wearing equestrian helmets. One person touches her face. The woman points to different red patches on her forehead, chin, and neck as the camera zooms in for extreme detail of the skin texture. (4) The woman is seen in various outdoor settings, including what appears to be a market area. She continues to inspect and touch the red, swollen areas on her neck and jawline. (5) In the final scene, she is shown from the chest up holding a large plastic cup containing an orange-colored drink. She takes a sip while variety-show style text overlays appear on the screen.
